verdict.rationale: Stable pairs its virtual business address with a nationwide registered agent service from the same provider. That service handles state and legal mail, and Stable says it offers automated filing guidance and prefilled forms. Its API also models Companies as legal entities and lets you create registered agent Locations per jurisdiction. Missing for 10: any evidence of LLC formation, lease-grade addresses for foreign qualification, residency-grade addresses, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the bundled entity services.
